query_analysis.original_query: We’re designing a hybrid separation unit combining distillation and membranes. How do we determine the most energy-efficient split between these two stages?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a method to optimize the energy efficiency of a hybrid separation unit by determining the optimal allocation of separation tasks between distillation and membrane processes.

selected_agents.role: Hybrid separation process design and optimization

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative optimization of separation tasks guided by thermodynamic data and mathematical modeling
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated analysis and continuous feedback to refine energy efficiency
